svg.title: Three focus areas | spatial anchors and scenario cards
svg.desc: Zooms return to the same provisional polygons; each focus area gets a visible question, node sequence, and human fallback. All spatial layers are provisional or conceptual and must not be read as official redlines, engineering dimensions, permits, operations, or scores.

text.tspan: Three focus areas | spatial anchors and scenario cards
Zooms return to the same provisional polygons; each focus area gets a visible question, node sequence, and human fallback.
Same GeoJSON input · focus polygons are provisional · display transform only
Bound the machine test before it reaches ordinary
Ordinary arrival and observation forecourt → Human explanation and
takeover desk → Bounded API simulation and test boundary → Freeze, replay
human fallback and stop rule remain G0
Keep staffed, paper, phone, and screen-free options
Daily arrival and low-stimulation dwell → Paper, phone and staffed service
→ Reskilling and intergenerational learning → Screen-free recovery and
human fallback and stop rule remain G0
Make public data, explanation, and withdrawal
Cultural arrival and ordinary movement → Multilingual human explanation
and consent desk → Withdrawable display and bounded service → Redress,
human fallback and stop rule remain G0
The same provisional polygons are shown at overview and focus scale; scenario nodes, green-blue buffers,
public-space concepts and human fallback are read together. No line is an official redline or engineering alignment.
Official geometry and field baselines trigger a full geometry / metrics / figure / HTML / PDF / self-check
official_boundary=false · geometry_role=provisional_constraint · conceptual suggestion for professional deepening
